card.name: Digits and spaces in dates, studies
card.fires_on: Digits or the space before a number, such as a year or a study number, in passages about magnetism or multiple sclerosis trials. Also a few stray linking words or commas.

modes.label: Digits inside years
modes.description: A digit inside a year in text about the physics of magnetism and a Nobel Prize.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The space just before a study number or a figure in multiple sclerosis drug trials or magnetism text.

card.plain: It fires on the number or the space just before it, mostly in magnetism and MS trial text, and it discourages words like spin.
